compression: gzip, compression level 9, header mtime=0; decompresses to the exact supplied CSV bytes
unit: Borenstein/NBER aggregate operating-carrier-set × unordered airport-pair × quarter × coupon-category cell; not an individual ticket
citation: Severin Borenstein, Market Data files; hosted by NBER, Department of Transportation DB1A/DB1B, doi:10.60592/tb1p-9p78.
known_conversion_difference: 42 source carrier entries containing the literal code NA are blank in this supplied CSV (34 rows, 6453 sampled passengers). They are not repaired. All aligned numeric/airport values match the public archive within 5.01e-12.
upstream_boundary: This repository starts with the supplied aggregate CSV. Its relationship to the NBER aggregate archive was checked; raw-ticket screening was not independently reconstructed.
